title: transit: peer rate limiter params hardcoded (100 rps, burst 200)
description: Why: PeerRateLimiter::new(100.0, 200, ...) in main.rs:281-283 hardcodes the sustained rate (articles/sec) and burst capacity. Operators running high-volume transit nodes or restrictive test environments need to tune these without recompiling.\n\nWhat: Add [peering] rate_limit_articles_per_sec (default 100.0) and rate_limit_burst (default 200) to TransitConfig; wire into PeerRateLimiter construction in main.rs.
